title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
abstract: arXiv:2611.31225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. translated_title: 基于互信息最大化的自监督数据集蒸馏
translated_abstract: 数据集蒸馏（DD）旨在将大型数据集压缩成一个小型合成数据集，且该数据集在训练神经网络时仍然有效。尽管数据集蒸馏在监督学习中已取得成功，但其在自监督学习（SSL）领域仍缺乏充分探索——在自监督学习中，蒸馏数据必须保留学习跨数据增强保持一致的表征所需的信息。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了互信息原型对齐（MIPA），这是一种高效的自监督学习数据集蒸馏方法，通过优化合成图像来保留增强不变的信息。具体而言，MIPA将合成图像视为可学习的原型，并使用冻结的编码器根据特征相似度将真实样本分配给这些原型。一个保留了这种增强不变性的合成数据集，应当能在同一真实图像的多个增强视图上产生稳定的原型分配。MIPA通过最大化互信息来鼓励这种稳定性（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出MIPA方法，将合成图像视为可学习原型并通过最大化互信息来保留增强不变信息，实现了高效的自监督学习数据集蒸馏。
en_tdlr: MIPA introduces an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and maximizes mutual information to preserve augmentation-invariant information in distilled data.
